jobs.title: Data Management Lead - Agentic AI for Data
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.

**Job Summary**


As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.


This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. You will run structured discovery with business stakeholders to understand current workflows and friction points, then convert those insights into prioritized requirements and measurable outcomes. You will also support executive communications by synthesizing progress into concise narratives, metrics, and roadmap updates.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Define end\-to\-end requirements for the build of an agentic solution for the data persona that enables end\-to\-end data product development, in alignment with firmwide data guidelines and standards.
* Lead discovery with business teams to document current workflows, identify friction points, and translate needs into a prioritized intake backlog. Also demonstrate how the agent addresses these pain points.
* Design and run structured user\-feedback loops (interviews, shadowing sessions, usability tests, telemetry review) to continuously refine tool capabilities against real DPM workflows.
* Partner with engineering leads to convert business needs into well\-scoped technical requirements and discrete, assignable tasks for data engineers and AI engineers.
* Validate delivered capabilities by reviewing agent behaviors, generated outputs, and integrated workflows to ensure they match intent and agreed standards.
* Define and track acceptance criteria, success metrics, and evaluation frameworks (e.g., agent task\-completion rate, output quality, human\-in\-the\-loop intervention rate) for each capability release.Coordinate delivery execution through backlog refinement, sprint planning support, release readiness checks, and dependency management across teams.
* Contribute to the multi\-year roadmap for scaling the agentic tool from PoC to a firmwide platform – including capability expansion, LOB onboarding sequencing, and platform hardening.
* Develop a working point of view on the target agentic architecture: orchestration patterns, scheduling, agent\-to\-agent communication, memory/state management, tool registries, and evaluation infrastructure.
* Identify reusable components, shared services, and integration points with existing firmwide data platforms and skills repositories.
* Partner with governance, risk, controls, legal, and compliance stakeholders to ensure responsible use and appropriate controls are embedded into the solution. Collaborate and align with data engineers, data scientists, product managers, architects, and technology partners to achieve business outcomes.
* Drive coordination and communication with senior stakeholders to advance the DDLC strategy and secure ongoing sponsorship. Produce executive\-ready materials: roadmap updates, PoC readouts, adoption metrics, and business\-value narratives.




**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Demonstrated understanding of agentic artificial intelligence patterns, including single\-agent, multi\-agent, and orchestrated approaches.
* Working knowledge of generative artificial intelligence building blocks, including large language models, prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, context design, evaluation methods, and safety controls.
* Hands\-on experience using modern generative artificial intelligence development tools (for example, enterprise\-approved coding assistants or agent\-enabled integrated development environments).
* Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including deployment pipelines, continuous integration and continuous delivery, environment promotion, testing strategies, and observability.
* Working knowledge of the data development lifecycle, including data modeling, schema and contract design, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and publishing standards.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical work items, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience running pilots in a large, regulated enterprise environment, including stakeholder alignment and release discipline.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect senior stakeholder priorities to engineering execution.
* Track record of end\-to\-end delivery in data, data science, or data product work in consulting or internal consulting contexts.

* Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.

jobs.description:
**We're looking for a**
**Principal Product Manager \- HR Platforms \& Technology**
===========================================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Principal Product Manager \| HR Technology \& Platforms \| Hyderabad**
  

  

**Summary**


Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
  

This is a customer\-facing AI\-native product management role for a hands\-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI\-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
  

The ideal candidate is highly execution\-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor


**About the Team**


You'll join a growing product team building AI\-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal\-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.

In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.

* Ship a working AI\-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.

* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution\-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight

**In This Role You Will**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of new AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal\-setting, and talent development.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements, use cases, and solution concepts that can quickly be tested and refined.
* Identify opportunities for new agents to complement existing ones in the portfolio, contributing to a cohesive experience as agents are increasingly deployed together.
* Build and evolve working prototypes using AI\-native tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar rapid prototyping platforms, using prototypes as the new PRD motion so customers, FDEs, and engineering can review, test, and refine solutions directly.
* Collaborate closely with FDEs and engineering to validate feasibility, refine user flows, and prepare solutions for launch, working in tight feedback loops to confirm value and shape deliverable product capabilities.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across product, engineering, design, data science, architecture, and go\-to\-market teams to bring validated concepts into production.
* Turn customer specific outcome agents into re\-sellable out\-of\-the box agents.
* Ensure launched outcome agents are practical, scalable, and easy for enterprise customers to adopt.
* Use customer feedback, adoption signals, and business\-impact metrics to continuously improve product execution and outcomes.


**You Have Got What it Takes If you Have**


* 5\+ years of experience in product management, including significant experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or platform products.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-native prototyping and product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot or similar tools to accelerate product definition and validation.
* Strong track record in customer\-facing product delivery for enterprise SaaS or AI\-native products.
* Demonstrated ability to go from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes and launched solutions.
* Experience collaborating closely with customers and technical delivery partners such as FDEs to iterate rapidly and launch customer\-ready solutions.
* Strong product execution skills, including prioritization, prototype validation, release planning, cross\-functional coordination, and delivery tracking.

* Design, develop, and maintain Java\-based backend services using Core Java (8/11/17\).
* Build RESTful APIs and Microservices using Spring Framework and Spring Boot.
* Implement messaging and event\-driven architecture using RabbitMQ (queues, exchanges, routing keys, DLQs).
* Integrate with relational and/or NoSQL databases and write optimized queries.
* Apply best practices: SOLID, design patterns, clean code, unit testing, code reviews.
* Build resilient services using patterns such as retry, timeout, circuit breaker, idempotency, and graceful error handling.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (QA, DevOps, Product) across the SDLC.
* Troubleshoot production issues and support deployments with root\-cause analysis.

* Strong knowledge of **Core Java (OOP, Collections, Exception Handling, Streams, Concurrency basics)** .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Growth & Revenue
jobs.description:
We're hiring:
 




  





 Senior Product Manager — Growth \& Revenue —
 
 1acre.in
 
  






 Land is the most opaque market in India. People still get burned buying a plot because the basic information — is it verified, who owns it, what's the master plan, can I even reach the seller — is scattered or hidden.
 




  






 We're fixing that. 1acre is India's verified land \& plot marketplace: 16,000\+ verified lands and plots on one live map, real sellers you can contact directly, no spam. Mission is simple — solve the information problem in land. Verify it, make it instantly discoverable, help people transact at scale. Then take it global.
 




  






 The verification problem is largely solved. The next one is commercial: get found, get people to act, get paid. We're looking for a Senior PM to own that end to end — with AI as a force multiplier at every step.
 




  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**Organic SEO growth** 



* Land search is high\-intent and geographically fragmented — "agriculture land for sale in Sangareddy," "Guntur master plan," "HMDA layout survey number." Thousands of queries, real buyers behind each one.
* You own the page architecture, programmatic templates, internal linking, schema, indexation — and the content quality that keeps rankings once you win them.
* Measured on non\-brand organic sessions and organic\-sourced contacts. Not impressions.



  





**Engagement \& conversion** 



* Traffic that lands and leaves is a cost.
* You own the funnel from landing to contact: map and listing UX, filter comprehension, search\-intent matching, trust signals, and the WhatsApp handoff.
* WhatsApp is our primary conversion channel by design, not by accident.
* You should have a view on how to make it convert harder.



  





**Monetization** 



* Subscriptions, premium map layers, and the developer dashboard.
* Determine what's worth paying for, pricing, paywall placement, and how value is demonstrated prior to purchase.
* Own revenue and conversion\-to\-paid directly as key metric targets.



  





**Data intelligence \& API** 





 • Our layer data — survey numbers, master plans, metro, air funnels, cadastral, heritage — is the most defensible thing we have, and today only our own product consumes it. 
 





 • There is a plausible business selling it to developers, lenders, brokerages, infra consultants. 
 




  






 You own finding out whether that's real: packaging, pricing, the API surface, the first design partners. The founder runs early sales conversations with you. 
 




  






 • Converting demand signals into a product — or telling us clearly there isn't one — are both wins.
 




  





**Quality, end to end** 





 • Turn problems into specs crisp enough that both engineers and AI agents can build from them with zero guesswork. 
 





 • Partner with design (Figma) from idea to pixel — flows, edge cases, empty and error states, and the copy that goes with them. 
 





 • Own the test plan across buyer, seller, and developer journeys. Verify on real devices. Confirm the analytics events actually fire. Sign off before anything launches.
 




  





  





**HOW WE WORK** 




  





**We ship, then we decide.** 

 Something small in front of real users in two weeks beats two months of research. Kill rate is expected to be high and that's fine — killing your own work fast is a skill we value, not a failure we tolerate.
 




  






 • Weekly ship cadence. Cut scope rather than slip dates.
 





 • Every launch carries a metric and a decision date before it goes out. 
 





 • You instrument what you ship. Define the Mixpanel events yourself, build the funnel, read it honestly. 
 





 • If you need three rounds of validation before committing to a bet, you'll find this frustrating.
 




  





**YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU** 




  




* Have 4–8 years shipping products, with at least 2 owning growth, SEO, or monetization on a consumer or marketplace product.
* Have moved a number and can prove it — organic traffic, conversion rate, ARPU, paid conversion. Pick one and walk us through what you actually did.
* Know SEO for real. Not "managed an agency" — you understand crawl budget, programmatic page quality, cannibalization, and why most programmatic SEO decays.
* Are genuinely AI\-native — you use LLMs every day to spec, prototype, test, and analyze, and you have real opinions about where they help and where they don't.
* Write with precision. A spec from you leaves nothing ambiguous.
* Read your own data. SQL or a BI tool, funnels, cohorts, Mixpanel or equivalent. You don't wait for an analyst to tell you what happened.
* Treat QA as your job, not someone else's — it's not "done" until you've tried to break it.
* Know (or will rapidly learn) the Indian land context — survey numbers, plots vs lands, cents/gaj, master plans, district\-level nuance.
* Will go to the field. Some of this product cannot be understood from a desk in Hyderabad.
* Sweat the details AND move fast. Both, not one.



  





**BONUS POINTS** 




  




* Marketplaces, classifieds, proptech, or fintech background.
* Have productized or sold data or an API before, even at a small scale.
* Maps/GIS — Mapbox, QGIS, cadastral or survey records.
* Telugu, or another South Indian language, for user conversations.
* Early\-startup experience. You know what the first 20 people have to be like.
* Hands\-on with Figma, Linear/Jira, Mixpanel/Google Analytics, Search Console.



  





**WHY 1ACRE** 




  




* A real problem at real scale — every honest fix here protects someone's life savings.
* AI\-first for real — we ship with modern AI tooling, we don't just talk about it.
* Small team, high ownership, fast decisions. Your work goes live, not into a backlog.
* You own revenue\-facing surfaces from day one, reporting directly to the founder. No layers.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager — Platform, Integrations \& Agentic Workflows
   

  

**Company**
 Tailorbird (CapExOS)
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Reports to
   

  

 VP of Product
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Tailorbird builds CapExOS, the capital\-planning platform for institutional multifamily real estate. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to build the application and agentic layer of that platform — making it easy to onboard customers, easy to support integrations, and easy to run product operations. You will build on top of the infrastructure our Engineering team owns (asset entity model, MCP, data flywheel), orchestrating it with tools, agents, and MCPs so onboarding and data exchange become plug\-and\-play instead of a discovery → troubleshoot → triage → script → test → deploy cycle. Engineering owns the infrastructure and setup; you will have real influence over how it is shaped to support the agentic platform.
   

  

 What you will own
   

  

+ Agentic onboarding: A self\-service path where a customer’s inputs are ingested and a working sandbox is stood up — no data tickets, no bespoke scripts.
+ Integrations as product: Plug\-and\-play data exchange with customer systems (rent rolls, capex, PM, accounting tools) via agents and MCPs, not one\-off engineering builds.
+ Product operations: Turn manual, one\-off operational work into repeatable, agent\-driven flows with standard inputs and outputs, and own the tasks, tools, guardrails roadmap. What you’ll build The profile we need can think on their feet and stand up an agentic prototype that takes real customer inputs and produces a live sandbox in 3 days — data loaded, product explorable — with no data ticket, no engineer scripting an ingest, and no manual test, deploy loop. The same plug\-and\-play thinking applies to integrations. Must\-have experience
- Agentic product development: Non\-negotiable. Has shipped products built on tools, agents, and MCPs to connect workflows; thinks in orchestration, not traditional software builds.
- Integrations: Has owned integration, data\-exchange products and made them repeatable, not bespoke.
- B2B SaaS: Has repeated the 0→1 platform, integration motion across companies — pattern recognition, not first attempt.
- Operates at altitude: Can define scope and guardrails and drive cross\-functional execution with Engineering from day one. Bonus — real estate, proptech Direct experience with a real\-estate technology tool (multifamily, capex, PM, accounting data) is a massive plus. Working with Engineering Engineering owns the infrastructure and setup. This role owns the application and agentic layer on top of it — and has real influence on how the infrastructure is shaped to support that layer. This role owns: Application, agentic layer, Onboarding \& integration UX, Agent workflows, Tasks, tools, guardrails, Productizing services, Data exchanges, Customer self\-serve. Engineering owns: Asset entity model, MCP, Core data infrastructure, AI, Data flywheel, Data pipelines, Processing standards, Delivery cost. First 90 days
* Days 0–30: Map the onboarding \+ integration path; identify manual steps agents can replace; align scope with Engineering, Architecture.
* Days 30–60: Ship the first agentic prototype — customer inputs → live sandbox in 3 days on one real account.
* Days 60–90: Deliver one plug\-and\-play integration and a repeatable pattern; replace a recurring manual operational workflow with an agent\-driven one. How we measure success Time\-to\-sandbox ≤ 3 days (self\-serve); onboarding Engineering tickets per onboarding, integration trending toward zero; manual operational effort replaced by repeatable, agent\-driven flows.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------



Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world\-class customer experience every time.



We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best\-in\-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


**Capacity planning**


* Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
* Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff\-reduction recommendations
* Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source\-of\-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
* Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org\-wide capacity plan
* Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves


**Forecasting \& scenario planning**


* Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
* Build, update, and present "what\-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half\-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long\-range and financial planning
* Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support
* Build out and report on seasonality trends for a complex, growing organization


**Performance \& insights**


* Dig into historical data to surface insights that improve support operations, speed, quality, and customer experience
* Monitor service level performance, perform SL\-miss analysis, and feed those insights back into planning


**Staffing \& headcount**


* Guide short\-term staffing adjustments to close current gaps, and partner with Operations to track how staffing is implemented and optimized, driving proactive and corrective improvements
* Reconcile planned vs. actual headcount and budget with Finance/HR, monitor the hiring pipeline against plan, and track new\-hire ramp against expected productivity curves
* Maintain a risk register or contingency plan for capacity gaps such as surges, outages, or attrition spikes, and incorporate attrition, absenteeism, and other shrinkage assumptions into the model


**Cross\-functional partnership**


* Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting
* Partner with teams across operations, customer experience, product, engineering, and tools to improve processes and the resulting experience for customers and partners
* Hold regular capacity plan reviews with leadership, and flag service level risks — with supporting analysis and a recommended mitigation plan — for upcoming projects and initiatives
* Own your recommendations end\-to\-end: dig into the data, build the model, set implementation timelines, align partners, test ideas, and measure results

jobs.description:
### **Summary**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Location: Hyderabad, India  

  

About The Role:  

Enterprise Competitive Intelligence (ECI) is responsible for gathering, assessing, organizing, and delivering timely, relevant, high\-quality competitive intelligence that supports Novartis pipeline, portfolio, and strategic decision\-making. As ECI moves from a service\-provider model toward a strategic partnership model, the function needs scalable data systems, governed repositories, and AI\-enabled workflows that make validated CI accessible, reusable, and useful across business units.  

  

In this role you will shape and govern the ECI data systems and AI agenda: building and leading the CI knowledge layer, ensuring CI data is available, searchable, API\-ready and usable by AI, and enabling repeatable AI\-assisted workflows that improve speed, quality, consistency and enterprise leverage. The role will act as the bridge between ECI, business\-unit insights teams, Data Digital \& IT (DDIT), enterprise knowledge management teams (e.g. NKC), and relevant external partners to deliver pragmatic solutions while preparing ECI for future AI\-enabled ways of working.

**AI\-Enabled Workflows and Automation**

* Identify, prioritize and deliver AI\-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve quality in recurring ECI activities
* Develop reusable templates, prompts, workflow patterns and validation checkpoints that ECI associates can apply consistently across therapeutic areas and business\-unit requests.
* Partner with ECI leaders and specialists to define future\-state workflows before tool selection, ensuring AI augments expert judgement rather than replacing critical CI interpretation.
* Support pilots and MVPs over validated CI content and potential CI agent capabilities anchored in governed internal data.

**Governance, Quality and Access Management**

* Establish data governance standards for CI assets, including lineage, ownership, lifecycle, metadata, access policies, quality checks and decision rights.
* Ensure CI data is accurate, current, appropriately curated and protected, with expert oversight and clear escalation routes for sensitive or uncertain content.
* Coordinate access management across ECI, insights teams and broader approved user groups, balancing enterprise accessibility with confidentiality, compliance and business\-unit needs.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Enterprise Partnership**

* Create feedback loops with end users to ensure systems and AI workflows improve usability, relevance, trust and adoption across ECI and its stakeholders.
* Actively promote cross\-BU reuse of CI outputs and reduce duplication by making the right intelligence easier to find, compare and apply.

**Delivery, Vendor and Financial Discipline**

* Run a lightweight but rigorous delivery model across Data Systems and AI workstreams, including backlog management, MVP demos, milestone tracking, dependency management and risk escalation.
* Evaluate and manage vendors and pilots in the AI for CI space, including clarity on expected value, data requirements, procurement implications, integration feasibility and exit criteria.
* Manage the Data Systems and AI budget / project spend once approved, supporting timely forecasting, vendor decisions and efficient allocation of scarce resources.
* Help ECI leadership make transparent trade\-offs across repository build, AI workflow development, vendor pilots, external data feeds and internal technical capacity.

**Talent, Capability Building and Change Management**

* Build ECI capability in data systems, AI literacy, prompt/skill development, responsible AI use and data governance fundamentals.
* Lead or coordinate a small expert pod/matrix team of data systems, AI, repository and workflow specialists as the book of work evolves; this may evolve into a small team of direct reports

jobs.description:
Job Description
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1200\+ global enterprises to manage their 4\.5million\+ employees across 130\+ countries. Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: DP World, JG Summit, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.  

**Why Join Us?**
The way Darwinbox is evolving is unlike anything we have seen before. AI is transforming our platform, our customer experience, and the future of HR technology; this role will be at the forefront of turning that vision into reality. You will help bring our AI ambition to life in the field, working on high\-impact problems with strategic customers while shaping how Darwinbox scales its next generation of intelligent products. This is the founding cohort of an entirely new function at Darwinbox — the first FDEs will shape how the team operates, which customer engagements get the embedded model first, and how it scales. You will work zero layers removed from the customer and touch a stack broader than any pure product engineering role allows: the Darwinbox platform, Python at production scale, the LLM stack of your choice (Claude, GPT, Gemini), MCP servers, agent frameworks, and whatever the customer happens to run on their side.  

**You’ll experience a culture of:**
* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

**About the role**
The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Darwinbox's most strategic enterprise customers to ship production\-grade AI agents and Agentic Flows on the Darwinbox HCM platform inside each customer's environment. The role centres on three skill areas: production Python engineering for AI agents, deployment of LLM applications (prompt engineering at scale, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation frameworks), and architecting REST API and webhook integrations with payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, and ERP systems. You will work hands\-on inside customer environments on HR workflow problems that exceed the platform's standard configuration surfaces.  

**What you will do**
* Embed with 2–3 strategic enterprise customers in parallel as the technical owner of the Darwinbox deployment in their environment.
* Run discovery with CHROs, HRBPs, and HRIS leads to surface the real problem behind the stated ask and translate it into a working technical design.
* Deliver a working prototype within \~1 week of engagement kick\-off, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and channel field insights into the Darwinbox platform roadmap.
* Design and ship production\-grade AI agents on the Darwinbox platform for HR workflows including leave, performance, attendance, onboarding/exit automation, and HR decision support.
* Architect custom integrations between Darwinbox and customer\-side payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning platforms, and ERP stacks using REST APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven patterns.
* Travel 25–40 percent of the time to customer sites across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East as required.

**What we are looking for**
**Required**
* Hands\-on production Python engineering for enterprise SaaS, integrations, and AI agent development.
* Production deployment of LLM applications: prompt engineering at scale, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration, and evaluation frameworks.
* REST API and webhook integration design for systems interoperability (payroll, ATS, SSO/IDP, learning, ERP) with production\-grade auth.
* Customer discovery and technical translation with senior enterprise stakeholders (CHROs, HRBPs, HRIS leads).
* Production LLM experience and willingness to travel 25–40 percent — candidates with only academic/demo AI exposure or hard travel constraints are unlikely to be the right fit.

**Preferred**
* HCM domain knowledge across payroll, performance, attendance, talent, and recruitment workflows.
* MCP server implementation or agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and AI observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse).
* TypeScript or Java in addition to Python; multilingual capability across Hindi, English, or additional Indian / SEA languages.
* Former technical founder experience, or experience in enterprise SaaS environments such as Salesforce (Agentforce), Atlassian, Databricks, Uniphore, UnifyApps, Sprinklr, Freshworks, Zoho, or similar settings with hands\- on AI deployment work.

**Experience and qualifications**
* 1–4 years of professional software engineering experience, including customer\-facing (Hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related quantitative discipline; no certifications required.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

**About Saras Analytics** 




 Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast\-growing SMBs and mid\-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and IQ) as the data infrastructure underneath every engagement. Our consulting team is built around forward deployed analysts, data scientists, and subject matter experts who sit close to the client and turn data into strategic guidance CXOs act on.
 



  





**Why Now** 




 Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. Right now we're scaling our product implementations quickly — more clients, more concurrent engagements, more moving pieces, in a short span of time. A Business Analyst joining now is doing hands\-on work inside that scale\-up directly, not joining a fixed, fully mature process.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You'll work inside a Technical Project Manager's delivery pod, executing the hands\-on BA and BI work in the client engagements assigned to you — gathering requirements, building the analysis or dashboard, and confirming the client's team is actually using what you built. You'll report to your Technical Project Manager.
 



  





**The Level** 




 · Senior Business Analyst (\~4\-8 years) — you take on the most ambiguous requirements, set the quality bar for the pod's output, and coach the junior analysts around you.
 



  





**The Bar** 




 Your output is only as good as its accuracy — a dashboard or analysis that's wrong, or that doesn't answer the actual business question, isn't done. Getting the requirement right and the numbers right, every time, is the top priority for this role.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Get the requirement right, not just the ask. Understand what the client actually needs before you start building — ask the questions that get past the surface\-level request to the real business question underneath.
 



 2\. Write accurate technical requirements for cross\-functional teams, and define how their work gets validated. Translate the business requirement into a clear technical spec for the teams building the underlying data or pipeline work, then define the test cases that confirm what they deliver actually matches what the client asked for.

 4\. Get it reviewed and signed off before it ships. Validate your numbers, walk your Technical Project Manager through the logic, and get explicit sign\-off on scope before the client sees it. (Jr BAs only)
 



 5\. Help the client actually use what you built. Support training and walkthroughs so the client's team understands the dashboard or analysis, not just receives it.
 



 6\. Flag what's not working. If a requirement changes, the data doesn't support the ask, or a deadline is at risk, say so early, not after the fact. (Jr BAs seek support from their team)
 



  





**What Winning Looks Like** 




 First 90 days: you've shipped your first few analyses or dashboards independently, you know the tech stack and the Saras standards, and you can explain your work's logic clearly to both your team and the client.
 



 Steady state: your output is accurate and on time without needing rework, your Technical Project Manager trusts what you ship without re\-checking every number, your cross\-functional team mates enjoy working with you and the clients you support are actually using what you build.

 · You're a graduate of a reputed engineering college.

 · You're hands\-on proficient in SQL and at least one BI tool, either Tableau or Power BI — you build the dashboard, not just read it.
 



 · You can break down an ambiguous business question into a clear, testable analytical problem.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and develop the PMs / Builders in your cluster. You set the
 



 standard for how the cluster builds: solutions are prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from those prototypes rather than from a blank page. You report to the Product Lead.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own one or more modules end\-to\-end, not just the backlog, but the customer outcomes those modules drive. You’ll run customer engagements independently, work closely with business and engineering teams, and be the single point of authority for what gets built, deferred, and why. You don’t take requirements; you diagnose problems and prescribe solutions. You don’t just spec the build; you start it: you prototype the solution in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page. You report to a Principal PM / Lead Builder or a Senior PM / Senior Builder.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Problem Discovery \& Research
 



  




* Own customer engagements end\-to\-end: understand their problems, workflows, and success criteria well enough to prescribe, not just specify.
* Analyse data and signals to validate and size problems. Know the problem better than the customer does.
* Zero escalations without a recommended path and supporting reasoning.



  





 Customer Ownership
 



  




* Own Tier B or Tier C customer engagements end\-to\-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Solution customers independently, coordinating with other PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
* Be the single point of contact for your customers, not just during delivery, but through adoption and outcome validation.



  





 Solutioning \& Prototyping
 



  




* Define what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes, not stakeholder volume.
* Write PRDs that engineering can build from without constant clarification: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming.
* Build working prototypes in AI, not throwaway mockups. Your prototype is the foundation engineering builds forward from: developers extend the backend, harden it, and refine functionality from what you’ve already built. A large part of the build happens in your hands.
* Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation.



  





 Execution \& Delivery
 



  




* Own sprint delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams. Unblock issues before they become delays.
* Ensure milestone testing and validation happens before release. Own the quality bar for your modules.



  





 Release \& Adoption
 



  




* Define and track customer\-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
* Own post\-release adoption. A shipped feature with no adoption is a failure you own.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 4–6 years in product roles with demonstrated module or feature ownership.
* You diagnose problems from first principles and prescribe solutions; you don’t take requirements and execute.
* You use AI as a core part of how you work, not occasionally, but across every step of discovery, solutioning, and delivery, including building the prototype engineering carries forward.
* You make decisions in ambiguity with reasoning. You don’t escalate problems, you escalate recommendations.
* You think in outcomes, not outputs. You know the difference between shipping and delivering value.
* Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* Full module ownership on a platform that processes $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
* Direct engagement with enterprise customers: you own their outcomes, not just their tickets.
* Work with a team that has chosen to move first on AI: you’ll be operating at a level most product teams won’t reach for years.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

**About Tekion**
 Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a technically grounded and detail\-oriented Product Manager II to own a defined slice of the dealer experience and integrations surface within Tekion's GM Digital Retail Platform (DRP) program. This is a delivery\-focused product role — you will translate GM program requirements into well\-scoped, shippable capabilities that improve the dealer\-facing experience and keep the AEC–GM DRP integration reliable.
   

  

 You will operate at the intersection of OEM program management, platform engineering, and dealer\-facing product design — partnering with GM's business and technical contacts, Tekion's engineering squad, and Dealer Success. Working within the broader GM DRP roadmap set by senior and staff product leaders, you will own your features and integration workstreams end\-to\-end: spec, prioritise, deliver, and iterate.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support Cx Experience \- Support the GM DRP customer (Cx) experience — the consumer\-facing digital retail journey across vehicle discovery, deal configuration, F\&I presentation, and online\-to\-in\-store handoff. Own the delivery of assigned Cx capabilities within GM DRP, ensuring the consumer flow stays consistent with GM's brand and program standards and connects cleanly to the dealer workflow. Partner with Design and GM's Cx teams to translate customer journey requirements into well\-scoped, execution\-ready backlog items, and iterate based on customer behaviour and conversion signals.
* Support Integration Delivery \- Own the delivery of assigned integrations between Tekion's AEC platform and GM's DRP infrastructure —including inventory syndication, pricing/deal data sync, and status updates — working within the integration architecture and standards defined by senior product and engineering leads.
* Own the Scrum Team Backlog \- Write precise user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specs for your engineering squad. Maintain a groomed, well\-prioritised backlog that balances GM program milestones, dealer experience improvements, and platform stability.
* Contribute to Data Contracts \- Partner with platform and data engineering to define and document API schemas, webhooks, and event\-driven data flows for your features; help ensure data integrity across DMS, GM DRP, and third\-party systems.
* Partner on GM OEM \& Dealer Success Alignment \- Serve as a product point of contact for GM's business and technical teams on your workstreams; translate program requirements into well\-scoped deliverables and work with Dealer Success to capture and close field feedback loops.
* Track Feature Adoption \& Integration Health Metrics \- Define and monitor success metrics for your capabilities — dealer adoption, deal completion rates, integration reliability (uptime/latency), and error rates. Iterate on features based on data and dealer feedback.
* Support Integration Troubleshooting \- Build the technical depth to help diagnose API failures, data\-sync mismatches, and event\-pipeline issues on your surface, and partner with engineering to drive fixes to root cause.
* Drive Cross\-Functional Coordination \- Coordinate across Engineering, GM OEM, Dealer Success, Design, and Platform teams to resolve requirement conflicts, manage dependencies, and keep shared delivery timelines on track; escalate trade\-offs clearly.
* Support Change Management \& Dealer Adoption \- Partner with Dealer Success and enablement teams to build rollout plans, training assets, and adoption materials for new features and integration changes.
* Support Compliance \& Certification Readiness \- Ensure the features and integrations you own meet GM's compliance, security, and certification requirements, and contribute to quarterly OEM program reviews.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of Product Management experience In platform, enterprise SaaS, or OEM/B2B technology products. Experience owning both functional features and integration\-oriented capabilities is strongly preferred.
* Working understanding of system integrations Familiar with RESTful APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven data flows (Kafka or equivalent). Able to read and review API specs, identify integration gaps, and collaborate directly with engineers on resolution.
* Ability to translate OEM or enterprise requirements into specifications Demonstrated experience decomposing enterprise or OEM business needs into API contracts, data models, and well\-scoped engineering deliverables.
* Data\-driven mindset \- Experience defining KPIs, tracking adoption and reliability metrics, and iterating on product decisions based on quantitative and qualitative signals.
* Strong stakeholder collaboration \- Able to align engineering, OEM business contacts, and Dealer Success on scoped deliverables, and communicate trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication \- Able to write crisp PRDs, user stories, and integration specs, and communicate status and trade\-offs with clarity.

jobs.description:
Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The Battery Pack Product Owner is accountable for the end\-to\-end definition, delivery, and lifecycle management of one or more battery pack products across Agratas’ targeted markets (e.g., Passenger Vehicle (PV), Commercial Vehicle (CV), and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)). The role acts as the central integrator across systems engineering, design engineering, cell, BMS, manufacturing, and commercial functions, ensuring delivery of competitive, safe, compliant, and cost\-effective battery pack solutions aligned to customer and business needs.
   

  

 In addition to owning the battery pack product, the role is responsible for defining, managing, and coordinating Battery Management System (BMS) requirements, feature content, integration activities, and delivery execution to ensure successful deployment of complete battery system solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibility Areas
   

  

 Customer Interface and Technical Leadership
   

  

* Function as the main customer interface for technical battery system topics with the Agratas Program Management team.
* Lead cross\-functional alignment across Pack Engineering, BMS, Cell, Manufacturing, Systems Engineering, and Quality.
* Lead customer and supplier meetings with relevant engineering leads on battery system technical topics.
* Communicate development progress and lead resolution of technical concerns with engineering teams and suppliers.
* Provide technical leadership for battery system integration, including battery pack and BMS customer requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for customer concerns and technical trade\-off decisions.


 Development Planning and Execution
   

  

* Drive product trade\-offs across cost, performance, safety, manufacturability, serviceability, and scalability.
* Own product KPIs including cost, energy density, reliability, safety, and feature maturity.
* Plan and monitor battery pack and BMS development against program milestones.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Hardware, Software, and Systems teams to align program timelines and PI goals using SCRUM.
* Support PM in development timing, resources, cost estimates, and technical risk management.
* Lead BMS feature delivery and integration activities against program milestones.
* Coordinate hardware and software development for successful BMS deployment within the battery pack.
* Provide regular development status reports to internal and external stakeholders.


 Requirements Analysis and Product Definition
   

  

* Translate customer, regulatory, and business requirements into engineering product requirements.
* Own battery pack system definition, architecture, performance targets, and product features.
* Own BMS requirements, feature definitions, interfaces, and functional performance targets.
* Collaborate with customers, ESP, third\-party suppliers, Systems Engineering, and component teams to define and publish battery system requirements.
* Act as the primary customer contact for requirement reviews and approvals.
* Establish and maintain product requirement baselines and documentation throughout development.
* Own feature prioritization and requirement traceability across Pack and BMS development.


 Production Readiness and Quality Assurance
   

  

* Ensure battery system sign\-off and production readiness.
* Serve as Product Owner in Agile development, ensuring timely TLA, hardware, and software releases within the Agratas NPI process.
* Lead customer and supplier resolution of Pack, BMS, and integration issues throughout development.
* Support FTA, FMEA, 8D problem\-solving, and applicable quality documentation.
* Support Engineering and Quality teams in customer reporting and compliance validation.
* Own the battery system feature maturity matrix for Pack and BMS development.
* Oversee battery pack, BMS, and PDU integration, verification, and validation.
* Support ASPICE, ISO 26262, and ISO 21434 compliance activities where applicable.


 Strategic Planning and Roadmap Development
   

  

* Contribute to battery product strategy and technology roadmaps.
* Define future battery pack and BMS feature roadmaps aligned with customer and market requirements.
* Identify technology trends and integrate innovative battery system solutions.
* Work with R\&D teams and strategic partners to evolve battery system functionality and performance.
* Support Agratas\-owned battery system and BMS IP, requirements, models, tools, and engineering capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement in product functionality, quality, performance, and customer value.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
* Proven experience in HV battery systems, battery pack development, Battery Management Systems, and automotive control units.
* Strong background in automotive product development, qualification processes, and technical documentation.
* Experience managing system\-level requirements, product roadmaps, and cross\-functional development activities.
* Knowledge and experience with automotive quality management tools such as FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and 8D methodologies.
* First\-hand experience in ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity for Automotive Systems).
* First\-hand experience with CAN tools, diagnostics, requirements management tools, and JIRA (or equivalent) for project tracking and product management.
* Working knowledge of embedded software development, software release processes, and Agile methodologies (SCRUM).
* Understanding of HV battery packs, Battery Disconnect Units (BDU), Power Distribution Units (PDU), and battery system architectures.
* First\-hand experience developing battery pack and/or BMS architectures and their associated requirements.

jobs.description:
Back to jobs

 Product Manager
   

  

 Bangalore
   

  

 Glance AI is an AI commerce platform shaping the next wave of e\-commerce with inspiration\-led shopping, less about searching for what you want and more about discovering who you could be. Operating in 140 countries, Glance AI transforms every screen into a stage for instant, personal, and joyful discovery, where inspiration becomes something you can explore, feel, and shop in the moment.
   

  

 Its proprietary models, seamlessly integrated with Google’s most advanced AI platforms, Gemini and Imagen on Vertex AI, deliver hyper\-realistic, deeply personal shopping experiences across categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and more. Designed to seamlessly integrate into everyday consumer technology, Glance AI reimagines the future of e\-commerce with inspiration\-led discovery and shopping.
   

  

 With an open architecture built for effortless adoption across hardware and software ecosystems, Glance AI is creating a platform that can become a staple in everyday consumer technology. It partners with the world’s leading smartphone makers, connected TV manufacturers, telecom providers, and global brands — meeting people where they are: on mobile, smart TVs, and brand websites.
   

  

 Through Glance AI’s rich first\-party data and unparalleled consumer access, it harnesses InMobi’s global scale, insights, and targeting capabilities to create high\-impact, performance\-driven shopping journeys for brands worldwide. Part of the InMobi Group, a global technology and advertising leader reaching over 2 billion devices and serving more than 30,000 enterprise brands worldwide, Glance AI is backed by Google, Jio Platforms, and Mithril Capital.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Glance AI is building AI\-native consumer experiences for millions of users. We are looking for a Product Manager who combines strong consumer\-product judgment with a builder’s mindset. Someone who thinks deeply about how a product feels and behaves, not just what
   

  

 features it has.
   

  

 You will own consumer\-facing experiences end to end, from understanding the user problem and shaping the experience to launch, adoption, engagement, and iteration. This is a role for someone who moves fast, stays close to users and design, and is comfortable changing direction when a better idea emerges.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Own consumer journeys and experiences, not just individual features.
* Identify meaningful user problems and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Work closely with design to shape intuitive, engaging, and differentiated interactions.
* Think deeply about flows, states, feedback, discovery, and how users experience the product end to end.
* Drive activation, engagement, retention, and repeat usage.
* Work with engineering and AI teams to understand what is possible, where the experience can break, and the right product trade\-offs.
* Use user behavior, research, experiments, and judgment to improve the product continuously.
* Prioritize sharply and move ideas from decision to users quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3–6 years of product management experience, preferably in consumer technology.
* Experience building and shipping consumer products used at meaningful scale.
* Strong product taste and an instinct for good UX and interaction design.
* A deep understanding of user behavior and what makes experiences intuitive, useful, and habitforming.
* Ability to look beyond a feature request and solve the underlying user problem.
* Strong execution and prioritization skills.
* Comfort working through ambiguity and making decisions without perfect information.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration with design, engineering, data, and business teams.
* A hands\-on relationship with generative AI.


 You may have already shipped GenAI products, or you may be a strong consumer PM who actively experiments with AI and builds with it. What matters is that you are curious about what AI makes possible and can translate that into experiences that feel genuinely better for users.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We believe great products are built through strong judgment, rapid iteration, and close attention to the user experience. We test ideas early, learn quickly, and do not become attached to a solution simply because we built it. The best idea wins. We care about shipping, but shipping is not the goal. Building an experience users understand, enjoy, and return to is.

**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Product Owner, AVP
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India**
**Role Description**
 Currently DWS sources technology infrastructure, corporate functions systems \[Finance, Risk, HR, Legal, Compliance, AFC, Audit, Corporate Services etc] and other key services from DB. Project Proteus aims to strategically transform DWS to an Asset Management standalone operating platform; an ambitious and ground\-breaking project that delivers separated DWS infrastructure and Corporate Functions in the cloud with essential new capabilities, further enhancing DWS’ highly competitive and agile Asset Management capability.
   

  

 This role offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high performing team implementing a strategic future state technology landscape for all of DWS Corporate Functions globally.
   

  

**What We’ll Offer You**

 Best in class leave policy

**Project Role :** 
 Business Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high\-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology\-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Business Requirements Analysis
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

**Summary**
 As a Proxy Product Manager, you will be responsible for supporting product strategy, roadmap planning, backlog management, and delivery across cross\-functional engineering teams. You will act as a bridge between Product Managers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, and QA teams, ensuring that requirements are clearly defined, prioritized, and successfully delivered.
   

  

 The role requires strong expertise in product lifecycle management, Agile methodologies, requirements engineering, stakeholder management, and delivery planning, with the ability to independently drive product decisions and priorities in alignment with the overall product vision.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Support the Product Manager in defining product vision, roadmap, priorities, and release plans.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring effective prioritization.
* Translate business and customer needs into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, QA, UX, and business teams for successful delivery.
* Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, product reviews, and release planning.
* Analyze customer and stakeholder feedback and convert it into actionable product requirements.
* Manage dependencies, risks, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Act as the Product Manager s representative and make day\-to\-day product decisions when required.
* Track product progress using KPIs, product metrics, and delivery dashboards.
* Ensure features meet defined business objectives, quality standards, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Mentor Product Owners/Business Analysts and promote Agile product management practices.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Software Delivery.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum, product backlog management, and SDLC.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of requirements engineering, user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization, and product roadmaps.
* Experience working closely with software engineering, architecture, QA, and DevOps teams.
* Good understanding of APIs, cloud platforms, microservices, databases, and modern software architecture.
* Experience with product analytics, KPIs, dashboards, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Experience in Automotive, Embedded Software, ADAS, ECU, or connected products is an added advantage.
* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management abilities.
* Strong customer and business\-outcome orientation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, and dependencies.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills across cross\-functional teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Bachelor s or Master s degree in in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* Product Management, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent certification is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager — Customer & Delivery
jobs.description:
**The Role, in One Sentence**
 You own the bridge between Customer Success and Engineering — making sure engineering builds what customers can actually use, and making sure customers understand, adopt, and champion what gets built.
   

  

**The Three Metrics You Will Be Measured On**
**Product usage — are customers actually using the modules they pay for**
**Product champions — are there named people inside our accounts who advocate for us**
**Recurring revenue — retention and expansion, as an outcome of the first two**
 Everything below serves these three. If an activity doesn't move one of them, it isn't the job.
   

  

**What This Job Actually Is**
 Read this section carefully. It is the most important part of this posting.
   

  

 What It Means Day to Day
   

  

 \~40% Product
   

  

 Owning the roadmap for existing modules. Prioritisation. Writing specs. Relentlessly simplifying — fewer clicks, less jargon, usable by a 55\-year\-old warden and a 19\-year\-old student alike. Deciding what does not get built.
   

  

 \~30% Engineering \& Delivery
   

  

 Sprint planning, grooming, scope management, release coordination, UAT, post\-release verification. Working daily with our Tech Lead and engineering team.
   

  

 \~30% Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

 Product demos. Feature training. Webinars. Roadmap sessions that get customers excited about what's coming. Gathering requirements first\-hand rather than second\-hand.
   

  

 Travel is occasional, not routine. Most customer work is remote. Expect on\-site visits some months and none in others.
   

  

**What This Job Is Not**
* Not account management. We have a Customer Success team. They own accounts, escalations, support tickets, and day\-to\-day service. You do not.
* Not a growth role. There is no funnel to optimise, no experimentation programme, no PLG motion. If your last three years were Mixpanel dashboards and A/B tests, this will make you unhappy within six months.
* Not pure product, not pure engineering. You will not sit in Figma all day, and you will not be writing code. You will spend your time translating in both directions — and the translation is the value.


**What You Will Own**
 Product
   

  

* Roadmap for existing modules — user management, leave and attendance, tickets and assets, mess, amenities, checklists, visitor management, finance, notifications
* Prioritisation across competing asks from Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering
* Simplification as a discipline. Our users are not software people. When engineering ships something in six clicks, your job is to ask why it isn't three. When a screen uses internal terminology, your job is to catch it before a customer does.
* Saying no — to customers, to Sales, and to engineering — with a reason that holds
* Protecting the roadmap from one\-off customisations that fork the product


 Delivery
   

  

* Sprint planning, grooming, and release coordination with the Tech Lead and engineering team
* Turning requirements into specs engineering can act on, with the "why" intact
* UAT and post\-release verification — confirming it works for the customer, not just in staging
* Never committing a date engineering hasn't agreed to


 Customer\-Facing Product Work
   

  

* Product demos that make non\-technical institutional buyers want the product
* Training existing customers on new features so they actually get adopted
* Webinars and roadmap sessions across the customer base
* Building product champions inside accounts — the people who will renew and expand us
* First\-hand requirement gathering, so we aren't building from a game of telephone


 Systems, Not Heroics
   

  

* Every commitment logged. No verbal promises that live only in your head.
* Building the process so it runs without founder involvement.


**Must\-Haves**
* 3\+ years of full\-time product management, post\-graduation, with real ownership specs, prioritisation, sprints, releases.
* Demonstrable ability to run an excellent product demo to a non\-technical audience. This is tested, not taken on trust.
* Experience with external paying customers. Internal\-platform\-only PMs do not fit — you need to have built for people who could leave.
* Sprint ownership: planning, grooming, scope, release. Not "worked alongside a Scrum Master."
* A demonstrated instinct for simplification an example where you removed steps, jargon or complexity from a product and can explain what it did to adoption.
* Requirements ownership: you have interrogated a request, not transcribed it.
* Written English strong enough to send an email to a university Dean without review.
* Bengaluru\-based or genuinely relocating. This is an onsite role.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Education, EdTech, campus, or institutional software
* Products used by low\-digital\-literacy or non\-technical user bases
* Experience running customer webinars, training programmes, or feature\-adoption campaigns


 Explicitly Not Required
   

  

 Mixpanel
   

  

* Amplitude
* A/B testing
* funnel and cohort analytics
* PLG
* SQL
* growth experimentation
* consumer product background.


 These will not improve your candidacy. Their absence will not hurt it.
   

  

 Skills: edtech,sprint planning,customer engagement

jobs.title: Product Owner II
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Product Analyst role will drive growth and innovation in Experity’s product portfolio. Serving today’s end users while meeting the expanding needs of our growing client base, this person will work closely with Product Managers, development and engineering teams, and other key stakeholders. This role will serve as the subject matter expert between product and engineering to ensure the features brought to life in Experity products align with the company vision, market needs, and deliver technologies that improve the healthcare industry. The Product Analyst will collaborate and align with their manager peers to ensure that the persona(s) and journey effectively represents the interactions and hand\-offs between each step.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Contribute to the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for product enhancements.
* Conduct customer\-centric, data\-driven product discovery, including regularly observing customer interactions (sales, install, service, support) and conducting customer interviews.
* Manage risk in new product efforts through value, usability, feasibility, and business testing, measuring and reporting results.
* Contribute to the creation of and update/maintain user personas.
* Contribute to the creation of and update/maintain the journey map as the product(s) evolve.
* Work closely with product manager, users, and internal stakeholders to ensure features are the best possible market fit.
* Create and author items in the engineering tracking system in the required formats (such as Gherkin) in the smallest consumable amount of work, ensuring they contain clear acceptance criteria.
* Create and manage the engineering backlog and sprint plans for your scrum team in concert with the overall product strategy.
* Maintain and ensure target process features are up to date with rollout plans, including feature gates, beta customers, and rollout type.
* Ensure each release has a feature for rollout at beta and production and stories written to enable clients accordingly.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams of product managers, designers, engineers, and product quality to ensure delivery against the product roadmap.
* Drive transparency to backlog details, progress, roadblocks, and other key metrics (across partners, Agile teams, senior leadership, etc.).
* Participate in support/Kanban standups, as needed.
* Represent your product in formal executive settings and reviews.
* Partner with the go\-to\-market team to prepare operations, marketing, sales, account management, and support product channels for launch.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Product Design, Business or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Two years of progressive product owner/management experience in healthcare technology or clinical imaging solutions.
* PACS, RIS, imaging workflow products, or similar imaging informatics solutions experience preferred.


**Experience**
* Two years of product owner experience.
* Experience in defining and delivering a roadmap of features that improve NPS and top\-line revenue.
